Today, he had found a whole human heart.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一个尚未醒来的巨人。街灯把空旷的马路染成昏黄，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，车灯划破寂静，又迅速消失在街角。二十四小时便利店的灯还亮着，玻璃后面坐着一个打瞌睡的店员。远处高楼零星几扇窗透出微光——那是失眠者、加班的人、或正在喂婴儿的母亲。环卫工人的扫帚声沙沙作响，成了这座城市最早的晨曲。天边渐渐泛起灰白，整个城市在混沌中悄悄酝酿着苏醒。", "w03": "- Imagine you're in a line of friends, and you ask the friend in front of you what page they're on; if they don't know, they ask the person in front of them.\n- The question keeps getting passed forward until it finally reaches someone who actually knows the answer.\n- Then the answer travels back, friend by friend, until it reaches you — that's recursion: solving a big problem by asking smaller versions of the very same question."}
